description: This Dart file defines the AuthProvider class, which manages authentication state, session restoration, login/logout, biometric unlocking, and protected API calls for a Flutter application. It interacts with external services like token storage, biometric authentication, and API client.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages authentication state, session persistence, biometric unlocking, and API interactions for user authentication.

methods.name: AuthProvider.uninitialized
methods.description: Factory constructor for creating an uninitialized AuthProvider instance.

methods.name: AuthProvider.rebind
methods.description: Binds dependencies like token store, biometric service, and API client to the provider.

methods.name: AuthProvider.ensureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures the session is restored if possible; initializes the provider.

methods.name: AuthProvider.restoreSessionIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts to restore an existing session using stored refresh tokens.

methods.name: AuthProvider.login
methods.description: Performs user login with username and password, obtains tokens, and updates state.

methods.name: AuthProvider.lock
methods.description: Locks the session with a specified reason.

methods.name: AuthProvider.unlock
methods.description: Attempts to unlock the session using biometric authentication.

methods.name: AuthProvider.logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, attempting backend logout if possible, then clears local tokens.

methods.name: AuthProvider.callProtectedMe
methods.description: Calls the /me API endpoint to fetch user information, handling token refresh and locking on failure.

methods.name: AuthProvider._proactiveRefreshIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically refreshes tokens if they are close to expiry.

methods.name: _requireTokenStore
methods.description: Ensures that the token store is bound and accessible.

methods.name: _requireBiometric
methods.description: Ensures that the biometric service is bound and accessible.

methods.name: _requireApi
methods.description: Ensures that the API client is bound and accessible.
